articles.title: Is Nvidia the Next Cisco? What the Dot-Com Crash Says About the AI Sell-Off
articles.summary: Nvidia posted a blockbuster quarter, yet its stock has cratered 41% in a month, and Wall Street keeps whispering Cisco. One set of numbers cuts against the chart, and one upcoming forecast could decide which story wins.

articles.title: Cisco Stock Fell 15.5% Despite Its Strongest Growth in 15 Years. Is the Dividend Safe?
articles.summary: Cisco just posted its best growth in over 15 years, yet investors rushed for the exits. For income seekers, the real question is what the numbers behind that payout reveal, and which lever management would pull first if demand cools.

articles.title: Cisco vs. HPE: One Has Better Financials, the Other Has 93% Upside. Which Stock Wins?
articles.summary: Cisco and HPE both power the AI buildout and pay dividends. We compare their financials, payouts, and analyst targets to find the better buy.

articles.title: How Investors May Respond To Cisco Stock After Earnings Beat
articles.summary: Cisco Systems reported past Q1 FY2027 results with revenue of US$18.5b, net income of US$4.6b, higher EPS than a year earlier, raised full year guidance, and a higher AI infrastructure outlook alongside new AI focused alliances with DXC Technology and Qumulo. The combination of stronger fundamentals, Cisco's US$9b AI infrastructure revenue target from hyperscalers and real world security and IT operations partnerships signals heavier reliance on AI driven networking and software to support...
